sources.title: Zero-shot domain transfer with a text-to-text model
sources.snippet: Example solutions for zero-shot domain transfer with a text-to-text model train a text-to-text model for a target domain using unlabeled in-domain text training data, and concurrently train the model using labeled general-domain task training data.

sources.title: Zero-Shot Transfer: Mechanisms & Applications
sources.snippet: Zero-shot transfer is the ability of AI models to apply knowledge from labeled source tasks to novel, unlabeled tasks and classes. It employs mechanisms such as semantic embeddings, shared encoders, and meta-learning to enable robust cross-domain and cross-task adaptation.
